content.text:
Here is a comprehensive codelist for wrist fracture, including specific fractures of the distal radius, distal ulna, and carpal bones, as well as relevant eponymous fractures (e.g., Colles', Smith's, Barton's, Galeazzi), and wrist-level fracture-dislocations/subluxations. Metacarpal fractures are excluded unless they specifically indicate a carpometacarpal fracture-dislocation, as the metacarpals are part of the hand. Non-current conditions such as sequelae are also excluded.

messages.content: List the OriginalReadCode, exactly as it appears in the source data, of every code in your final codelist. Include every code you selected and nothing else.

detect_codelist(code_terms = code_terms).answer:
Here is a comprehensive codelist for wrist fracture, including specific fractures of the distal radius, distal ulna, and carpal bones, as well as relevant eponymous fractures (e.g., Colles', Smith's, Barton's, Galeazzi), and wrist-level fracture-dislocations/subluxations. Metacarpal fractures are excluded unless they specifically indicate a carpometacarpal fracture-dislocation, as the metacarpals are part of the hand. Non-current conditions such as sequelae are also excluded.

Here is a comprehensive codelist for wrist fracture, including specific fractures of the distal radius, distal ulna, and carpal bones, as well as relevant eponymous fractures (e.g., Colles', Smith's, Barton's, Galeazzi), and wrist-level fracture-dislocations/subluxations. Metacarpal fractures are excluded unless they specifically indicate a carpometacarpal fracture-dislocation, as the metacarpals are part of the hand. Non-current conditions such as sequelae are also excluded.

content.text:
Here is the codelist for **Wrist fracture**, which includes fractures of the distal radius, distal ulna, carpal bones, and specific fracture-dislocations of the radiocarpal/wrist joint (e.g., Colles', Smith's, Barton's, Galeazzi, and Chauffeur's fractures). Metacarpal (hand) fractures have been purposefully excluded.
